description: This file defines the class cConfigDobby which provides methods to generate container configuration JSON for Dobby, including environment, storage, network, seccomp, and other settings. It also includes methods to create default configurations and handle various container setup aspects.

classes.name: cConfigDobby
classes.description: Class for generating container configuration JSON for Dobby, including environment, storage, network, seccomp, and other settings.

methods.name: createEnvConf
methods.description: Creates environment variables configuration for the container based on configNode.

methods.name: createStorageConf
methods.description: Generates storage configuration including loopback, dynamic mounts, and mount owners.

methods.name: createThunderConfig
methods.description: Creates Thunder plugin configuration if enabled.

methods.name: createMinidumpConfig
methods.description: Creates Minidump plugin configuration if enabled.

methods.name: createOOMCrashConfig
methods.description: Creates OOMCrash plugin configuration if enabled.

methods.name: createMemCheckpointRestoreConfig
methods.description: Creates MemCheckpointRestore plugin configuration with mount points.

methods.name: createGamepadConfig
methods.description: Creates Gamepad plugin configuration if enabled.

methods.name: createLocalTimeConfig
methods.description: Creates LocalTime plugin configuration if enabled.

methods.name: createNetworkConf
methods.description: Generates network configuration including IPv4, IPv6, DNS, multicast, and port forwarding.

methods.name: createSeccompConf
methods.description: Creates Seccomp configuration based on a profile file.

methods.name: generateMountPoints
methods.description: Generates mount points configuration from XML node.

methods.name: createRootfsConf
methods.description: Creates root filesystem configuration including mount points and move content.

methods.name: genereteUserSettings
methods.description: Generates user and group ID mappings and additional gids if privileged.

methods.name: createLxcConf
methods.description: Creates the full LXC container configuration JSON, merging various settings.

methods.name: createConsoleConf
methods.description: Creates logging configuration for console output.

methods.name: createDefault
methods.description: Provides a default container configuration template.
